reason: Confirmed that FR-TEST-HYG-112 (functional.md:360) says `The message \`not a failure: %+v\` no longer exists.` without a file, and that six such lines remain in other `internal/amazon` test files. But the sentence sits inside a requirement about the navigation failure helper's message, and the acceptance criterion (functional.md:579), TC-002 and run 3 now limit the grep to `browser_navigation_test.go`, where it prints nothing. title: Scope FR-TEST-HYG-112's 'no longer exists' sentence to the navigation failure helper
todo:
**Problem:** In `doc/specifications/test-suite-hygiene/functional.md` line 360, FR-TEST-HYG-112 says `The message \`not a failure: %+v\` no longer exists.` with no scope. `grep -rn '"not a failure: ' internal/amazon/` still prints six lines in other files (`browser_test.go:364/383`, `browser_retrieval_test.go:417/568`, `browser_profile_test.go:136`, `browser_interrupted_test.go:59`), which this issue left alone on purpose (FR-TEST-HYG-114). Read literally, the sentence is not met. The acceptance criterion at line 579 is already limited to the file.

**Suggested work:** Reword the sentence to `The helper no longer uses the message \`not a failure: %+v\`.` (or `... no longer exists in internal/amazon/browser_navigation_test.go`). Shorten or drop the now-stale note `Note on the "not a failure: " grep (TC-002)` in `doc/changes/2026-11-28-0058-issue-219-fold-the-redundant-amazon-answer-check-i/no-tests.md` (line 42 onwards). It still says the specification's grep covers all of `internal/amazon/`.
